[sc00terMcTav] Honest question, what does the floor cleaner for a robot vac like this do differently than a normal floor cleaner liquid from woolies for example?
[ace310] I guess it's more to keep the internal of the vacuum healthy rather than anything else. Majority of the cleaners are corrosive, so they are special.
[life is suffering] This is basically a scare /money making tactic . Manufacturers will void warranty if you use non branded ones saying oh it will coagulate the system block wtf. Another money making machine
[Tyrx] $2.22 per 100 ml for fake roborock cleaning solution is not a good deal. You can get higher quality products than this for like 6x less at Bunnings.
[puffinfresh] https://www.bunnings.com.au/peerless-jal-5l-versadet-floor-c…
[Tyrx] You want a pH-neutral, low-foaming floor cleaner. Something like Peerless JAL Versadet works out much cheaper than robot branded solutions even before being diluted (often hundreds of litres per bottle, depending on the dilution ratio).
For regular cleaning, I'd say plain water is honestly all you need though. The branded cleaning solutions tend to be pretty poor value for money for day to day mopping.
